verdict.rationale: Community discussion shows Llama models appearing on the independent LMArena leaderboard and being compared favorably to Claude/Gemini (llama-comm-10, llama-comm-18), but the same community tier also reports that Meta submitted a special 'conversational-optimized' chat build to LMArena rather than the released model, casting doubt on how representative those leaderboard rankings are (llama-comm-17), and other threads note Llama papers omit comparisons to frontier models like GPT-4/Claude Opus (llama-comm-9). All of this evidence comes from a single tier (community/forum discussion) with no first-party docs or independent benchmark publications in the pack, so it can't be treated as a firm cross-tier dispute, only a partial, caveated picture. missing for 10: first-party or third-party documentation citing specific independent leaderboard rankings (e.g., LMArena, HELM, Open LLM Leaderboard) with methodology, corroboration from a second evidence tier beyond community commentary, and rebuttal/clarification of the LMArena optimized-build controversy.
